title: How a Godly Man Finds the Brothers Who'll Actually Call Him Out
caption:
A godly man doesn't do this alone. Scripture never meant for you to.

Pick men who know your actual life, not your highlight reel. Give one man your real number. Show up on the weeks you don't want to. Let a brother ask the question you're avoiding.

Iron doesn't sharpen iron over a text thread. It takes the same room, over and over.
